title: CNO - FortiGate Bridge
description: Reads fortigate.* metrics from Grail every minute and re-emits them as cno.* so the Network Insights app renders FortiGate devices. Port of scripts/fortigate_bridge.py (same mapping; see METRIC-CONTRACT.md). The FortiGate extension keeps running untouched; this is translation, not a second poll. BEFORE INSTALLING: replace the two REPLACE_ME_* placeholders in the script below with your tenant's live.dynatrace.com host and an Api-Token that has metrics.ingest scope.
